credit_factors.label: Repayment history
credit_factors.what: Paying on time. It matters more than anything else.

credit_factors.label: Credit enquiries
credit_factors.what: Every application stays on file for 12 months.

credit_factors.label: Limits and debt
credit_factors.what: High limits and balances read as risk.

credit_factors.label: Defaults
credit_factors.what: Unpaid debts sent to collection stay for years.

credit_factors.label: Buy now, pay later
credit_factors.what: Short term credit. Plans and missed instalments show on your file.

actions.label: Daily check-in
actions.why_rewards_you: One a day, worth very little. It cannot be farmed.

actions.label: Seven days in a row
actions.why_rewards_you: A full week of checking your file is what turns awareness into habit.

actions.label: Answered a question
actions.why_rewards_you: Answering helps the AI personalise your plan. Low value so it cannot be farmed.

actions.label: Completed a plan goal
actions.why_rewards_you: A goal only completes when the data says it happened.

actions.label: On-time repayment
actions.why_rewards_you: Repayment history is the biggest factor in your score.

actions.label: No new BNPL this month
actions.why_rewards_you: Fewer enquiries and less debt protects your file.

actions.label: Set a repayment reminder
actions.why_rewards_you: A reminder is the step that makes an on-time payment happen.

actions.label: Covered a debit at risk
actions.why_rewards_you: Stopping a dishonour keeps your account in good standing.

actions.label: Tracked a money pattern
actions.why_rewards_you: Tracking lets us watch the pattern and confirm what really happens.

actions.label: Verified a saving
actions.why_rewards_you: Only awarded when the old debit stops appearing in your transactions.

actions.label: 4-week savings streak
actions.why_rewards_you: Consistency is what actually moves a score.

actions.label: Shop purchase
actions.why_rewards_you: Spending coins never earns XP. Rewards only come from money habits.

goals.title: Your dragon checks your file daily
goals.description: It re-reads your transactions every day. Seven days in a row fills this.

goals.title: Pay every Afterpay and Zip on time
goals.description: Each instalment on or before its due date, verified against your transactions.

goals.title: Go a month without new BNPL
goals.description: Thirty days without opening a new plan. Your last one was 27 days ago.
